name: Butt kicks

phases.name: left up
phases.cue: Kick your left heel up towards your glutes

phases.name: left down
phases.cue: Land softly on the ball of your foot

phases.name: right up
phases.cue: Kick your right heel up, arms pumping

phases.name: right down
phases.cue: Land softly and keep the rhythm quick

formTips: Keep your thighs pointing down and bring the heels up behind you
Stay tall with your chest up
Pump your arms as if jogging
Stay light on the balls of your feet
commonMistakes: Swinging the knees forward instead of kicking the heels back
